build.buildCommand: npm install --include=dev && npx prisma generate --schema=apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --workspace=apps/api

deploy.startCommand: npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss --schema=apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && npx ts-node apps/api/prisma/seed.ts && npx ts-node apps/api/prisma/seed-users.ts && node apps/api/dist/src/main
